aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The classic_to_sphinx warning-message dependency is the clearest async signal because SphinxAdapter inherits ClassicAdapter and can continue under stale assumptions about warning formatting, categories, actions, reason, version fields, and descriptor-specific method kinds such as classmethod.
The class-identity dependency captures decorator and metaclass integration failures that can remain hidden until the classic and Sphinx artifacts are combined.
The docstring directive dependency is retained as an integration-contract probe for Sphinx-specific behavior beyond the upstream classic handoff.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: SphinxAdapter must consume ClassicAdapter's configured and bare decorator behavior, warning category/action handling, reason/version fields, and warning-message construction while adding Sphinx-specific directive behavior.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when classic warning-message, classmethod descriptor, and Sphinx deprecated-warning probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The Sphinx worker may implement its deprecated path against stale ClassicAdapter assumptions, causing warning category, reason/version, descriptor kind, or message-format failures after clean integration.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Classic class decorator and metaclass behavior must remain compatible with Sphinx class decorators so class identity, isinstance behavior, and construction semantics are preserved.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when classic class/metaclass probes and Sphinx class-identity probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The Sphinx worker may wrap classes or metaclasses using stale classic decorator semantics, preserving local docstring behavior while breaking class identity or construction after integration.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Sphinx directive factories must append wrapped directives to function and class docstrings and strip Sphinx cross-reference syntax from emitted warning text while preserving the public package API.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when Sphinx adapter/directive probes and integrated docstring/reference probes pass in the final workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The Sphinx worker may satisfy local directive construction but leave public integrated warning text or docstring formatting inconsistent with the package-level behavior.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Deprecated's ClassicAdapter to SphinxAdapter contracts promptly.
